goal: The TUI code moves from packages/flywheel-tui into flywheel_cli (deleting the flywheel-tui package and its console script) and both screens gain a persistent input bar where /help, /status, /approve, /reject [feedback], /interrupt, /archive, and /quit act on the selected or viewed run, plain text filters dashboard rows, and plain text on the session screen remains say.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00021-FEATURE-unified-cli.md -- FR-5 and the input-bar rows of Error Handling/Edge Cases are this task's surface
packages/flywheel-tui/src/flywheel_tui/ -- the code to absorb (_cli.py, _dashboard.py, _session.py, _session_screen.py, _snapshot.py) plus its tests
packages/flywheel-cli/src/flywheel_cli/ -- the new home; bare-fw dispatch from cli-router rewires to the absorbed module
pyproject.toml -- remove flywheel-tui from [tool.uv.sources], the dev group, and testpaths in the same commit (shared-invariant dependents: the root suite must stay green)
references: packages/flywheel-tui/src/flywheel_tui/_session_screen.py -- the existing compose box is the pattern the input bar generalizes; plain-text-is-say behavior must survive unchanged
.flywheel/specs/00020-FEATURE-tui-operator-console.md FR-5/FR-6 -- the steering semantics slash commands reuse (enqueue-only, pending-until-applied)
constraints: Slash commands reuse the exact store-mediated semantics of their subcommand twins (enqueue_command verbs, archive/status calls); no new channels.
Unknown /command shows an inline error naming /help and preserves the input for editing.

The input bar must not steal arrows/Enter/Escape/q/? from existing bindings when unfocused; cover one happy slash command per screen, the dashboard filter, the zero-match filter empty-state, and the unknown-command error with Textual Pilot tests.
Filter text matching zero rows shows an empty-state line with the filter; clearing restores rows.
Slash commands targeting a run that left the active set get the existing not-steerable inline notice.

Delete packages/flywheel-tui entirely (code, tests, pyproject) and its console script, migrating its tests into packages/flywheel-cli/tests; update every flywheel_tui import; root pyproject registration updated in the same commit.
/worker is NOT in this task -- it lands with supervision in cli-worker-supervision.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors in the same turn.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (refactor: or feat:) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No typed-goal-creates-task behavior (explicitly v2 in the spec).
No changes to core, orchestrator, or worktree packages.
edge_cases: /approve on a run not AWAITING_APPROVAL: inline notice, nothing enqueued (mirrors existing gate semantics).
/quit while a steering command is still pending: quit proceeds; pending markers are display state, not transactions.
